Produce a test alert payload to the designated Alert Node's __alert__ topic.

Verifies the Alert Node is configured and produces a sample alert
JSON to the topic. The designated node (if running) will receive it in
its main(Data) function.

Does not require the node to be running — Kafka retention queues the
message until the node starts consuming.
